newsitem.title: UK: Dollar, Chicago rally boost soft oils in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Dollar, Chicago rally boost soft oils in Europe.

text.p: Soft oils opened steady on Thursday morning in the Europe supported by a strong dollar and Wednesday's rally in Chicago.
Chicago soybeans and meal closed lower but oil futures ended higher on light commercial support.
In Europe soft oils opened with soy oil 1.25 to two guilders up and rape oil 1.25 guilders higher.
"Some people have gone short on oil and sellers seem to think they may try and cover now," said one trader.
Palm oil remained weak with opening crude palm oil sellers $2.50 down after Aug and Aug/Sep traded at 512.50 a tonne cif.
Lauric oils were again neglected with opening coconut oil sellers $2.50 to $5 down while palmkernel oil was $5 lower to unchanged.
